name: HTN v4 - C: Recording-comparable normotensive comparator (2nd normal BP reading index)
description: Always-normotensive, treatment-naive comparator mirroring the elevated-BP target (5441): persons with >=2 BP readings ALL normal (never SBP>=130 or DBP>=80), indexed on the 2nd normal reading with a prior normal reading within 365 days, >=365d prior observation, age>=18, identical exclusions to the target (CVD, thyroid, secondary HTN, antihypertensive exposure, kidney disease, eGFR<60). Recording-comparable by construction to dissolve PS separation. SQL-derived: docs/research/hypertension-v4/normotensive_comparator_generation.sql.
